True 8K Resolution The bigger the screen, the more pixels matter. 8K resolution delivers 33 million separate pixels, compared to about 8 million pixels for 4K resolution. That massive increase in pixels means that even a big 85” screen will have a high pixel density that always delivers a crisp, clear image.² Everything you watch upscaled to 4K or 8K Samsung Neo QLED and QLED TVs feature deep learning AI algorithms that can upscale low-resolution images into high-resolution 4K or 8K images. Is a QLED TV worth it? A QLED TV uses tiny particles that glow when lit, called Quantum Dots, to deliver higher brightness and more accurate, vivid colors. Because each dot emits a precise hue, QLED displays maintain rich color no matter how bright the screen. It’s worth getting a QLED TV if you want a more immersive experience for movies, sports, or gaming. QLED screens create a vivid viewing experience that really draws you into the action.
